definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize that something is genuine or to express sincere feelings.
Used to confirm or agree with something strongly.

examples.japanese: {本当|ほんとう}にありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you so much. / I really appreciate it.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{本当|ほんとう}に{面白|おもしろ}かった。
{本当|ほんとう}にそう{思|おも}いますか？

notes: This is the adverbial form of {本当|ほんとう} (truth/reality). In casual speech, it's often shortened to ほんとに or even ほんと. Similar to {本当|ほんとう}の (true/real) as an adjective.
